## Setup
```{r load-packages, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Load libraries
library(rprojroot)
library(dplyr)
library(Seurat)
library(patchwork)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(SeuratObject)
library(scCustomize)
library(AUCell)
library(msigdbr)
library(sccomp)
library(pheatmap)
library(fgsea)

# Define directories
root_dir <- find_root(has_dir(".git"))
data_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "data", "v4")
analysis_dir <- file.path(root_dir, "analyses", "murine-cart-tumor")
results_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "results")
plot_dir <- file.path(analysis_dir, "plots")

# Source custom theme
source(file.path(root_dir, "figures", "theme.R"))

# set random seed
set.seed(1234)
```

## Load Data
```{r load-data}
# Load Seurat object
myeloid_obj <- readRDS(file.path(data_dir, "cart_myeloid_subtypes.rds"))
```

## Composition analysis using sccomp
## 41BB-L is set as the reference condition
```{r composition-analysis-sccomp, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 41BB-L (first level) is used as the baseline reference
sccomp_input <- myeloid_obj@meta.data |>
  tibble::rownames_to_column("cell") |>
  dplyr::select(
    cell,
    sample = sample,
    cell_group = myeloid_subtype,
    condition
  ) %>% mutate(condition = factor(condition,
               levels = c('41BB-L', 'B7H3', 'CD28-41BB', 'CD8-41BB', 'STOP', 'tumor'))) %>%  
  as_tibble()

cat("Reference condition for sccomp:", levels(sccomp_input$condition)[1], "\n")

sccomp_result = 
  sccomp_input |>
  sccomp_estimate( 
    formula_composition = ~ condition, 
    .sample = sample, 
    .cell_group = cell_group,
    bimodal_mean_variability_association  = TRUE,
    cores = 4,
    verbose = FALSE
  ) |> 
  sccomp_test()

# Save sccomp result
write.table(
  sccomp_result,
  file = file.path(results_dir, "sccomp_41BBL_baseline_results.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)
```

```{r visualize-sccomp-results, fig.height=6, fig.width=12}
sccomp_result |> 
  plot_1D_intervals()
ggsave(file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_subtype_composition_sccomp_41BBL_baseline.pdf"), width = 14, height = 6)
```

## Subtypes Not Significantly Altered vs 41BB-L (All Conditions)

```{r}
## Identify myeloid subtypes that are NOT significantly different 
## from 41BB-L across ALL treatment conditions
not_sig_subtypes <- sccomp_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(parameter != "(Intercept)") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(c_FDR < 0.05)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any_sig) %>%
  dplyr::pull(cell_group)

print(not_sig_subtypes)

cat("\nSummary:\n")
cat(length(not_sig_subtypes), 
    "myeloid subtype(s) show no significant compositional change relative to 41BB-L across all conditions.\n")
```

## Subtypes Not Significantly Altered vs 41BB-L (CAR Constructs Only)

```{r}
## Restrict analysis to CAR constructs only (exclude STOP and tumor)
res_cars_only <- sccomp_result %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    parameter %in% c(
      "conditionB7H3",
      "conditionCD28-41BB",
      "conditionCD8-41BB"
    )
  )

## Identify subtypes not significantly different across CAR constructs
not_sig_subtypes_cars <- res_cars_only %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cell_group) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(any_sig = any(c_FDR < 0.05)) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!any_sig) %>%
  dplyr::pull(cell_group)

print(not_sig_subtypes_cars)

cat("\nCAR-only Summary:\n")
cat(length(not_sig_subtypes_cars),
    "myeloid subtype(s) show no significant compositional change relative to 41BB-L among CAR constructs only.\n")
```

## Myeloid stacked barplot
```{r myeloid-stacked-barplot}
prop_df <- myeloid_obj@meta.data %>%
  count(condition, myeloid_subtype) %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n))

# Save proportions
write.table(
  prop_df,
  file = file.path(results_dir, "myeloid_subtype_proportions.tsv"),
  sep = "\t",
  quote = FALSE,
  row.names = FALSE
)

ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = condition, y = prop, fill = myeloid_subtype)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
  theme_Publication() +
  theme(panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        plot.background  = element_rect(fill = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = DiscretePalette(n = length(unique(prop_df$myeloid_subtype)))
  ) +
  labs(fill = NULL) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ylab("Proportion") +
  xlab("Condition") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format())

ggsave(filename = file.path(plot_dir, "myeloid_subtype_proportions_stacked_barplot.png"), width = 8, height = 5)
```
